intent: Add bench command comparing none vs AppCDS vs AOT cold starts
Add StartupBench, BenchReport and the bench command

name: StartupBench
role: Starts the app as a fresh JVM per run and times launch to ready; drops warmup runs
conditions: Pass an exit mode without warmup traffic, or warmup is counted as startup

name: MemoryProbe
role: Reads peak RSS: VmHWM on Linux, polled ps elsewhere
conditions: Sampled value is a lower bound; spring-refresh exits at ready so the last peak can be missed

name: BenchReport
role: Builds the Markdown table from medians; first variant is the baseline
conditions: Median, not mean, so one odd run does not move the result

name: AppOptions mixin
role: Shared picocli options for build and bench
conditions: Option names must stay stable; bench uses 20 ms poll for timing regardless of --poll-interval-millis

subject: Warmup traffic in timing
why: HttpProbeExitMode runs warmup requests inside its ready condition, so a timing run must use a probe without them

title: Measure with a probe that has no warmup traffic; train with the full one
why: Warmup requests belong in training but would be counted as startup in timing; a fixed 20 ms poll keeps every variant's resolution equal
alternative: One exit mode for both — rejected: silently inflates every variant

title: Report sampled peak RSS as a lower bound, read from /proc or ps
why: Kernel VmHWM is exact on Linux; ps polling is the portable fallback; both avoid changing the JVM under test
alternative: JVM-internal measurement (NMT/-Xlog) — rejected: alters what is measured

title: Move shared app options into an AppOptions mixin for build and bench
why: One definition stops the two commands drifting; option names are unchanged and build tests pass
alternative: Copy options into bench — rejected: drift

title: Define 'started' as the exit mode's ready condition, with one discarded warm-up run per variant
why: Same moment for all variants, no log parsing; the first run pays one-off file-cache costs
alternative: Parse Spring 'Started' log line — rejected: Spring-only and fragile; no warm-up — rejected: first run skews median
